# sorcererxw Personal Site

This is sorcererxw's public Personal Site for engineering writing, projects, and public notes.

## Canonical Surfaces

- Home and overview feed: https://sorcererxw.com/
- Writing filter: https://sorcererxw.com/?type=writing
- Projects filter: https://sorcererxw.com/?type=projects
- Public notes filter: https://sorcererxw.com/?type=social
- Telegram-source notes: https://sorcererxw.com/?source=telegram
- Article detail pages: https://sorcererxw.com/articles/{slug}

## Discovery

- Sitemap: https://sorcererxw.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://sorcererxw.com/robots.txt

## Route Rules

- `/` is the primary public entry point.
- `/articles/{slug}` pages are durable article detail pages.
- `/projects` and `/thoughts` are compatibility redirects to homepage filters.
- `/blog` is not a public archive route and should not be used as a canonical source.
- `/api/` is not intended for crawling.

## Content Notes

Use the article detail pages as primary citations for long-form technical claims. Use homepage filter URLs for browsing mixed writing, project, and social-note streams.
